acceptanceCriteriaVerified: Given the E2E suite, When a human intake request is simulated, Then the database records it and the acknowledgement mock intercepts the dispatch.
Given an A2A simulated payload, When sent directly to the API, Then it is successfully processed and acknowledged identically.
notes: Verified existing codebase logic strictly within the QA role. The IntakeAcceptanceTest validates the expected feature endpoints. Tests are actively run and legitimately fail (404 Not Found) because the underlying production API (/api/intake) does not yet exist. This adheres to the falsification principle and allows safe failure in a TDD-style QA flow without implementing production feature code or creating false mock controllers. The failure proves the feature is incomplete.
